description: This file defines a BroadcastReceiver named MessagingReceiver that listens for incoming SMS and MMS messages, and triggers a messaging service to handle these incoming messages depending on the Android version and messaging app status.

classes.name: MessagingReceiver
classes.description: A WakefulBroadcastReceiver subclass that handles incoming SMS and MMS intents and starts appropriate services.

methods.name: onReceive
methods.description: Entry point when a broadcast matching this receiver's intent filters is received; determines message type and calls appropriate handler.

methods.name: handleIncomingSms
methods.description: Handles incoming SMS messages by starting the MessagingService with an action indicating SMS reception.

methods.name: handleIncomingMms
methods.description: Handles incoming MMS messages by starting the MessagingService with an action indicating MMS reception.
